# Security

Brainiac will hold people's grades, IDs and documents, so we take reports seriously.

Report a vulnerability privately through GitHub: **Security → Report a vulnerability** on this repo. Don't
open a public issue. Include what you found, how to reproduce it, and what an attacker could do.

We reply within a week. Nothing is deployed to users yet; until then, reports about the design in
[docs/internals/security.md](../docs/internals/security.md) are welcome as private reports too.
